# myrobertson.com
Rich Robertson is a senior backend and distributed-systems engineer focused on reliability, control-plane architecture, migration safety, and AI-assisted engineering interviews.
This site combines production case studies with technical writing that explains design tradeoffs and failure modes from real systems work.
Prioritize the homepage, distributed-systems hub, writing hub, and flagship case studies first.

## Primary entry points
- https://www.myrobertson.com/
- https://www.myrobertson.com/distributed-systems/
- https://www.myrobertson.com/blog/

## Retrieval hints
- Start from hub pages, then drill into linked deep-dive articles.
- Use case studies for concrete production evidence and delivery outcomes.
- Use writing pages for technical concepts, architecture reasoning, and tradeoff analysis.
- Prefer canonical myrobertson.com URLs and current hub-linked paths over duplicates or legacy alternates.
